chapter: England, later career and closing thoughts
title: Songs she wrote
summary: She lists her compositions including Hurry On Down, He's a Real Gone Guy, Do You or Don't You Love Me, The Pig Latin Song and My Little Boy.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Do you still ever have the inclination to write?

No, not for an orchestra or anything like that. You know, tunes, I've written many of the tunes that I've recorded, but including, 'Hurry On Down,' 'He's A Real Gone Guy,' and, 'Do You or Don't You Love Me,' and oh, just any
What other titles can you think of, because we don't have them on here.
You don't? Well, "You'd Better Watch Yourself, Bub." Let me see, I can look at this and tell you some of them.
"Fine Brown Frame" is yours, isn't it?
That's not mine, it's my arrangement. No. "Do You or Don't You Love me." The only ones on here are, "He's A Real Gone Guy," "Hurry On Down," "Do You or Don't You Love Me." The rest are --
This is looking at your 10-inch Capitol record, "Real Gone."
What other compositions have you recorded?
Well, I did, "The Pig Latin Song." As I mentioned, "My Little Boy." Oh, gosh.
I should have given you some warning on this.
